data.rawText: ARCHITECTURAL PORTFOLIO Jean-Michel Basquiat 2023-2025 | Selected works JEAN-MICHEL BASQUIAT I am a recent graduate with a Bachelor of Design majoring in architecture (B.arch) from Northbridge University. Throughout my studies I have developed a strong interest in creating socially driven designs that are responsive to the respective sites whilst upholding environmental considerations. In the representation and communication of these designs I have developed skills both digitally and analogically which I aim to transition to practical and technical expertise of a junior architect with an optimistic desire to learn. I am committed to being a positive contribution to the team by maintaining efficiency through excellent communication, organisation, and problem solving skills.
